response.overview: Nicky Spinks, 51 year old fell runner, farmer record breaker, inov-8 athlete and breast cancer survivor, has completed double rounds of two of the three British classic 24-hour mountain challenges, having already bagged doubles of the Bob Graham in England and Charlie Ramsay in Scotland. In 2019, she took on the final round in the set, and the one which is considered the most difficult - The Paddy Buckley Round. No-one has ever completed a double Paddy Buckley, which has twice the amount of ascent as Mount Everest.
response.title: The Double Paddy Buckley Round
